# Brief: tone and mood, plus UI strings

Two tasks. Read `SKILL.md`, `references/tone-mood.md` and `references/ui-copy.md` first.

## Task 1: an email

Write an email from Orlando, the billing lead at Lumen Books, to a customer named Priya Nair.
Facts, all of which must appear:

- Her card ending 4471 was declined on 6 October 2026.
- The account stays active until Friday 10 October 2026; after that it pauses.
- She updates the card at lumenbooks.example/billing.
- Billing can be reached at billing@lumenbooks.example.

Setting: **professional tone, concise mood.** Nothing else is known about her.

## Task 2: a destructive dialog and its toast

A user is about to delete a project called "Q3 budget" from a workspace shared with 4 other
people. Deleted projects can be restored from Trash for 30 days. Produce the strings for the
confirmation dialog (title, body, confirm button, cancel button) and for the toast after deletion
(including an undo). Deliver them as a key table for the developer. Setting: the product default.
